latHint: Think making an earnest appeal to a lawmaker - not a hotel entrance.
pivHint: A LOBBY is an entrance hall - but to LOBBY a lawmaker is to ______ your case to them.
winText: Heard out. LOBBY was the pivot - an entrance hall to PLEADing your case.
lossText: PLEAD - to appeal earnestly. LOBBY was the pivot: an entrance LOBBY to LOBBYing a lawmaker.
